description: Browse the live catalogue, optionally filtered to one category. Omit category for everything. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing.

category.description: Exact category name. Call with no category first to see the valid values.

network.description: Only listings that accept USDC on this network: base, solana, or a CAIP-2 id. Omit for all. Each listing reports its rails in `networks`.

name: list_apis
title: List the PayAPI Market catalogue
